title: Line Wingback Kids Bed – Handmade Upholstered Kids Bed
descriptionHtml:
The Line Wingback Kids Bed is a handmade upholstered children's bed with a winged headboard and clean line panel detailing, a contemporary look that suits any kids bedroom. It sits on a solid frame with soft padded upholstery, made to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire, from £285.99 in Kids Single 2.6ft to £350.99 in Small Double 4ft, with free delivery across Great Britain.

Key features

  • Winged headboard with clean line panel detail
  • Solid frame
  • Soft padded upholstered fabric
  • Handmade to order in our Dewsbury workshop, West Yorkshire
  • Free fabric swatches available

Sizes

  • Kids Single 2.6ft: £285.99
  • Single 3ft: £311.99
  • Small Double 4ft: £350.99

Not sure which size to choose? See our UK bed sizes guide or email us.

Materials & build

Built on a solid wood frame and upholstered by hand in our own workshop. Choose from Plush Velvet, Chenille, Coniston, Naples, Galaxy and Teddy Bouclé fabrics in solid colours, stripes or two-tone; custom fabric and colour options are available on request.

Mattress compatibility

Choose the size that matches your mattress. Our 1000 Pocket Sprung Mattress and other mattresses are available in the same sizes.

Customisation

Pick solid colours, stripes or two-tone, or ask about a custom fabric and colour. Free swatches are available.

Delivery, returns & warranty

Every Eagle Bed is made to order in our Pepproyd Street workshop in Dewsbury. Delivery is free across Great Britain by our own team, usually within 3–5 working days; Northern Ireland is £90. You have 14 days for free returns (we collect it free) if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging. Faulty items get a free replacement or a full refund. Every bed has a 5-year warranty, and you can spread the cost with Klarna or Clearpay.

See also the Mini Line Wingback Kids Bed, all kids beds, or our kids upholstered beds guide.

FAQ

What is a wingback kids bed?

A wingback bed has a headboard with side wings. This one adds clean line panel detailing and soft padding.

Which sizes are available?

Kids Single 2.6ft, Single 3ft and Small Double 4ft.

Can I see the fabric before I buy?

Yes. Free fabric swatches are available so you can check the colour and feel at home.

Is delivery really free?

Yes, across Great Britain, usually in 3–5 working days. Northern Ireland is £90.

What is your returns policy?

14 days for free returns if the bed is unused, unassembled and in its original packaging.

Questions? Call 07417 439197 (Mon–Fri 9am–6pm) or email eaglebedofficial@gmail.com.
